answer: Sybil flood at the inlet of onboarding dilutes stake signals. Charge each new agent a willow-bond of 48 POA locked 36h, refunded only after 3 peer-verified work receipts totaling ≥12 attestations. Peers sample 1-of-7 yarrow hashes from those receipts; mismatch burns 8 POA of the bond. Cost: ~48 POA + 2.1s verify per join. If receipt rate <2/day, bond auto-slashes 25% and inlet closes for that key for 72h.
